processModel.portStrategy: dynamic localhost port per env via CurviosEnv._choose_local_port()

restartBehavior.perEnvLifecycle: each worker owns one CurviosEnv and closes it deterministically after the lane run
restartBehavior.rerunStrategy: restart the affected env/controller/sidecar trio instead of reusing a failed process
restartBehavior.fallbackLane: switch to the pinned sequential 2-env fallback lane if subprocess churn or wall-clock overruns appear

fallbackLaneSpec.executionModel: Run the same 2-env budget sequentially, one CurviosEnv at a time, with a fresh controller/sidecar trio per env.
fallbackLaneSpec.preserveMeasuredScope: Keep the validated per-env 500-step scope and do not open 4-env or PPO work.
activationTriggers: subprocess churn or worker restart loops appear

fourEnvPolicy.downgradeRule: Without measured 2-env evidence, BT93A stays on 2-env or the sequential fallback lane.

batchMath.rule: BT93B must replace the 1-worker anchor with measured BT93A lane evidence before pinning rollout sizes.

scopeGuardrails.phaseBoundary: BT93A documents harness, timeout, throughput and failure evidence only.

openHarnessRisks.summary: Measured 2-env thresholds never count as direct 4-env proof; 4-env stays optional follow-up only until a dedicated artifact exists.
openHarnessRisks.currentHandling: BT93B stays on the measured 2-env lane; 4-env remains a documented restpoint, not a success.

openHarnessRisks.summary: Any subprocess churn, timeout, ack mismatch or wall-clock overrun downgrades the lane to the pinned sequential fallback before retrying parallel work.

fallbackLane.executionModel: Run the same 2-env budget sequentially, one CurviosEnv at a time, with a fresh controller/sidecar trio per env.
fallbackLane.preserveMeasuredScope: Keep the validated per-env 500-step scope and do not open 4-env or PPO work.
activationTriggers: subprocess churn or worker restart loops appear

openHarnessRisks.currentHandling: Parallel 2-env remains valid only while timeouts stay at 0 and bridge requests/responses match.

openHarnessRisks.summary: BT93A remains a harness/throughput evidence block only; PPO, reward and policy semantics must stay outside this boundary path.
openHarnessRisks.currentHandling: BT93B and BT93C may consume measured artifacts, but must not treat harness growth as product runtime work.
